content.comment_body: Hello, I'm testing a [product_name] communication module, which was set up to send me warning notifications via email. However, I'm consistently getting an error stating "E-Mail could not be sent due to a certificate problem. E-Mail will be discarded." I upgraded the module's firmware from [version_no] 8.2 to 8.3, but the issue appeared already with the previous version. Current settings in the module include: - Summertime/wintertime is disabled - Access control with password protection is enabled and the password is configured in the module - Clock synchronization with [product_name] switch is active - NTP settings are all disabled SMS messages are received without issue and the wireless signal strength seems fine, so connectivity does not appear to be the problem. Has anyone experienced similar certificate issues or does anyone have further suggestions on potential solutions?
System time in the [product_name] communication module

analysis.insight_summary: The user describes persistent email notification failures on a [product_name] communication module due to certificate errors. Attempts to update the firmware and adjust configuration settings have not solved the problem, though SMS messaging and network connectivity remain functional. This points towards ongoing issues with email certificate management on the device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants dependable email warnings from the [product_name] communication module, seeking automatic and error-free certificate handling so that notifications are not interrupted.
